name: LLM Preference and Reasoning Pipeline Template
summary: Reusable base CDG for LLM, language-model efficiency, fine-tuning, alignment, safety, hallucination, preference, and reasoning competitions that combine prompt construction, paired or sequence encoding, supervised/LoRA/QLoRA adapter fine-tuning, efficient training controls, Bradley-Terry or contrastive preference heads, safety-aware attention, Constitutional-AI or self-labeling data, NLI claim/proposition verification, RLHF-style supervision, and calibration or thresholding.
dejargonized_summary: Prepare prompts, claims, or paired responses, encode them with an LLM or cross-encoder, adapt the model with supervised fine-tuning or lightweight adapters, optionally add safety labels, self-labeled examples, NLI evidence, or RLHF preference data, train a preference, safety, hallucination, or reasoning head, and calibrate outputs for ranking, detection, or scoring tasks.

inputs.name: prompt_or_pair_data
inputs.constraints: Prompts, responses, labels, comparisons, or relevance pairs.

outputs.name: ranked_or_scored_outputs
outputs.constraints: Scores, labels, rankings, or selected responses formatted for the benchmark metric.

use_when: The task is scored by pairwise preference, response quality, alignment, safety, hallucination detection, misconception matching, reasoning quality, or prompt-response relevance.
Inputs contain prompts, answers, response pairs, generated text, claims, evidence, candidate misconceptions, or query-document pairs.
A pretrained LLM, DeBERTa-style cross-encoder, LoRA/QLoRA adapter, instruction-tuned model, or efficient fine-tuning stack is a load-bearing representation stage.

Winning techniques include QLoRA, LoRA-MoE, adapter routing, FlashAttention-2, paged optimizers, bf16/mixed precision, gradient accumulation, Bradley-Terry ranking, contrastive preference learning, safety-aware attention, Constitutional AI self-labeling, NLI fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented verification, data distillation, instruction tuning, RLHF, or synthetic self-play data.
do_not_use_when: The task is ordinary tabular classification with no prompt, response, pair, or ranking structure.
The target output is a continuous physical quantity and no language model representation is needed.
applicability.key_insight: The durable topology is paired or prompt-aware representation before preference, reasoning, or ranking supervision; the exact LLM backbone is swappable.

swappable_stages.llm_or_cross_encoder: Can be DeBERTa, Llama, QLoRA, LoRA-MoE, a cross-encoder, adapter-routed model, NLI verifier, or another paired-input transformer if it preserves prompt-aware or pair-aware scoring.
swappable_stages.reasoning_augmentation: Can be external LLM data, data distillation, synthetic self-play, instruction data, Constitutional AI self-labels, rationale distillation, claim atomization, retrieval evidence, or RLHF-style preference examples.
swappable_stages.metric_calibration: Can be threshold tuning, rank averaging, Bradley-Terry normalization, multi-label safety calibration, or metric-specific rounding.

applicability.scaling_notes: Cache tokenization, use adapter or quantized fine-tuning for large models, and keep pair generation deterministic for reproducible validation.
failure_modes: Symmetry violations in response-pair ordering can leak label artifacts.
Prompt templates that differ between train and inference can break calibrated scores.
Cross-encoder context windows can truncate important evidence.

planning_constraints.subject: pair_aware_representation_before_scoring
planning_constraints.statement: Construct prompt or response pairs before training a preference, reasoning, ranking, or calibration head.
planning_constraints.rationale: The scoring stage assumes that prompt markers, pair ordering, and comparison direction are already encoded.

planning_constraints.subject: symmetric_pair_leakage_guard
planning_constraints.statement: Keep train, validation, and inference pair construction symmetric and split-aware.
planning_constraints.rationale: Preference and reasoning tasks can leak labels through pair order, prompt template drift, or generated rationale reuse.

audit.rationale: Added after support-3 expansion validation left repeated unmatched LLM preference, reasoning, hallucination, and misconception pipelines that were not base-plus-expansion variants of existing templates.
audit.dejargonized_summary: This captures language-model competitions where prompts or pairs must be represented before preference, reasoning, ranking, or calibration.
uncertainty_notes: Representative topology only; future solution-specific ingestion should decide which stages become expansions versus new atoms.

references.title: Sciona expansion support-3 validation audit
references.note: Local deterministic and semantic audit of unmatched solution patterns.

stages.name: Prompt Pair Construction
stages.description: Build prompt-response, query-document, misconception-answer, claim-evidence, proposition-level NLI, safety-label, or answer-pair examples with symmetric swaps and task-specific markers.
stages.dejargonized_description: Turn raw language records into paired or prompt-aware examples that preserve the comparison structure.
preconditions: Raw text fields and labels are available.
guarantees: Pair ordering and prompt markers are explicit.

stages.name: LLM or Cross-Encoder Representation
stages.description: Encode examples with a DeBERTa cross-encoder, NLI verifier, Llama-style model, LoRA/QLoRA adapter, LoRA-MoE adapter routing, safety-aware attention layer, or instruction-tuned transformer.
stages.dejargonized_description: Use a pretrained language model, often with lightweight adapters, to create pair-aware or prompt-aware representations.
preconditions: Tokenizer and context-length policy are fixed.
guarantees: Examples are represented in a shared embedding or scoring space.

stages.name: Reasoning Augmentation
stages.description: Optionally add chain-of-thought traces, rationale distillation, external LLM data, data distillation, quality filtering, synthetic self-play examples, Constitutional AI self-labels, proposition-level claim atomization, retrieval evidence for verification, instruction-tuning corpora, RLHF-style preference data, or prompt variants.
stages.dejargonized_description: Add reasoning traces, filtered training data, or extra generated examples when the task rewards explicit reasoning, alignment, or robust prompt coverage.
preconditions: Augmentation is generated without validation leakage.
guarantees: Augmented artifacts preserve target labels or preference direction.

stages.name: Preference or Reasoning Head
stages.description: Train a Bradley-Terry, contrastive preference learning, pairwise ranking, hallucination detection, NLI entailment/contradiction, multi-label safety regression, QWK, or calibrated classification/regression head.
stages.dejargonized_description: Convert language representations into the task-specific score, label, rank, or preference probability.
preconditions: Loss matches the benchmark target type.
guarantees: Scores are aligned to the task supervision.

stages.name: Metric Calibration
stages.description: Apply thresholding, rank normalization, symmetric averaging, Bradley-Terry normalization, safety-label calibration, retrieval-verification calibration, or integer rounding against the validation metric.
stages.dejargonized_description: Convert raw model scores into final benchmark decisions or rankings.
preconditions: Validation metric and calibration split are known.
guarantees: Outputs are formatted and calibrated for the benchmark metric.
